vercel-hobby-fast-data-transfer.label: Fast Data Transfer
vercel-hobby-fast-data-transfer.qualifier: listed under Hobby Included Usage; Hobby can't buy more, and going over a limit pauses that feature, in most cases for 30 days

vercel-hobby-cdn-requests.label: CDN Requests
vercel-hobby-cdn-requests.qualifier: listed under Hobby Included Usage; Vercel previously called these Edge Requests

vercel-hobby-blob-included.label: Vercel Blob included usage
vercel-hobby-blob-included.value: 1 GB of storage, 10,000 simple operations, 2,000 advanced operations and 10 GB of Blob Data Transfer a month
vercel-hobby-blob-included.qualifier: Hobby can't buy more; going over removes Blob access until 30 days have passed

vercel-pro-price.label: Pro plan price
vercel-pro-price.qualifier: platform fee including one deploying seat and $20 a month of usage credit; added seats and usage beyond the credit are extra

vercel-pro-cdn-capacity.label: Included Flat Rate CDN capacity
vercel-pro-cdn-capacity.value: 1 million CDN requests and 1 TB of data transfer a month
vercel-pro-cdn-capacity.qualifier: the lowest Flat Rate CDN capacity tier, included with Pro at no extra cost

vercel-flat-rate-cdn-next-tier.label: Next Flat Rate CDN tier
vercel-flat-rate-cdn-next-tier.value: $20 a month for 10 million CDN requests and 50 TB of data transfer
vercel-flat-rate-cdn-next-tier.qualifier: a billing cycle over capacity moves the team up a tier at the start of the next cycle; a one-day spike doesn't

vercel-flat-rate-cdn-ga-date.label: Flat Rate CDN general availability
vercel-flat-rate-cdn-ga-date.qualifier: the changelog entry says new Pro teams have Flat Rate CDN on by default and existing teams can switch over in Billing settings

vercel-pro-spend-notification-default.label: Default spend notification amount
vercel-pro-spend-notification-default.qualifier: Vercel enables spend management notifications at this amount by default for new customers

vercel-fast-data-transfer-on-demand.label: Fast Data Transfer on-demand rate
vercel-fast-data-transfer-on-demand.qualifier: applies to Pro CDN usage billed on demand, not to usage covered by a Flat Rate CDN tier

vercel-cdn-requests-on-demand.label: CDN Requests on-demand rate
vercel-cdn-requests-on-demand.qualifier: applies to Pro CDN usage billed on demand, not to usage covered by a Flat Rate CDN tier

vercel-fast-origin-transfer-on-demand.label: Fast Origin Transfer on-demand rate
vercel-fast-origin-transfer-on-demand.qualifier: usage-based on Pro; Flat Rate CDN doesn't cover it

googlebot-crawl-size-limit.label: Googlebot crawl size limit
googlebot-crawl-size-limit.value: the first 2MB of a supported file type
googlebot-crawl-size-limit.qualifier: reduced from 15MB; past the cutoff Googlebot stops the fetch and only the downloaded part is considered for indexing. Each referenced resource is fetched separately under the same cap. PDFs: 64MB

webflow-basic-price.label: Basic site plan price
webflow-basic-price.qualifier: USD; billed yearly, per site, plus tax; custom-domain Site plan without CMS. Monthly billing is recorded separately.

webflow-premium-price.label: Premium site plan price
webflow-premium-price.qualifier: USD; base rate billed yearly, per site, plus tax; includes CMS. Usage tiers and extras can change the total.

webflow-team-price.label: Team platform plan price
webflow-team-price.qualifier: USD; annual contract required. Includes a site and Workspace. Additional sites and extras must be agreed with Webflow sales; the included site does not require a separate Site plan charge

webflow-optimize-addon.label: Optimize add-on price
webflow-optimize-addon.qualifier: billed yearly ($379 billed monthly) for 25,000 page views, rising with page views, and charged separately from the site plan

webflow-localize-essential.label: Localize Essential price
webflow-localize-essential.qualifier: per added locale, billed yearly ($12 billed monthly), up to 3 added locales not counting the primary one. Localize Advanced is $29 a month per locale, up to 10

webflow-analyze-addon.label: Analyze add-on price
webflow-analyze-addon.qualifier: priced by sessions, and charged separately from the site plan

shopify-storefront-api-protocol.label: Storefront API protocol
shopify-storefront-api-protocol.qualifier: Shopify states there is no REST API for storefronts

shopify-storefront-api-content.label: Content available through the Storefront API
shopify-storefront-api-content.value: pages, blogs and articles, alongside products, collections, cart, checkout, search and customer accounts
shopify-storefront-api-content.qualifier: this is why Shopify can serve a headless site as well as a headless shop

woocommerce-store-api-scope.label: Store API scope
woocommerce-store-api-scope.value: unauthenticated cart, checkout and product endpoints at /wp-json/wc/store/v1/
woocommerce-store-api-scope.qualifier: WooCommerce describes it as public endpoints for customer-facing cart, checkout and product functionality

woocommerce-rest-api-scope.label: REST API scope
woocommerce-rest-api-scope.value: authenticated admin resources only, with no cart or checkout endpoints
woocommerce-rest-api-scope.qualifier: products, orders, customers, coupons, refunds, tax rates and reports; a headless storefront needs the separate Store API

wix-headless-price.label: Wix Headless entry price
wix-headless-price.qualifier: Wix states a premium plan is required to unlock payments, in-depth analytics and custom domains

wix-headless-solutions.label: Business solutions available headlessly
wix-headless-solutions.value: eCommerce, bookings, events, memberships, CMS and blog
wix-headless-solutions.qualifier: Wix states these sit under a single auth model and a consistent API pattern

squarespace-api-scope.label: Developer API scope
squarespace-api-scope.value: nine back-office Commerce APIs, with no content, page or storefront API
squarespace-api-scope.qualifier: Analytics, Contacts, Discounts, Inventory, Orders, Products, Profiles, Transactions and Webhook Subscriptions

webflow-cloud-frameworks.label: Frameworks deployable to Webflow Cloud
webflow-cloud-frameworks.value: Next.js, Astro, React, Vue, Svelte and plain JavaScript
webflow-cloud-frameworks.qualifier: deployed to Webflow infrastructure either standalone or mounted on an existing Webflow site at a path; the deploy wizard's built-in templates cover Astro and Next.js, and Webflow keeps official starters for the others

webflow-devlink-direction.label: What DevLink moves
webflow-devlink-direction.value: Webflow components exported as React components into an external codebase, and your own React components imported into Webflow
webflow-devlink-direction.qualifier: Webflow describes DevLink as the interface between external codebases and Webflow

gohighlevel-api-scope.label: Public API modules
gohighlevel-api-scope.value: CRM and contacts, conversations, calendar and events, opportunities, payments and webhooks
gohighlevel-api-scope.qualifier: Blogs and Funnels APIs are listed in the developer portal; whether they return renderable page content was not established

gohighlevel-starter-price.label: Monthly price
gohighlevel-starter-price.qualifier: or $970 a year; 3 sub-accounts; the Website & Funnel Builder is listed among the core features on every plan

gohighlevel-unlimited-price.label: Monthly price
gohighlevel-unlimited-price.qualifier: or $2,970 a year; unlimited sub-accounts and Basic API access

gohighlevel-agency-pro-price.label: Monthly price
gohighlevel-agency-pro-price.qualifier: or $4,970 a year; adds SaaS Mode and Advanced API access

gohighlevel-wordpress-hosting-price.label: Price
gohighlevel-wordpress-hosting-price.qualifier: an optional add-on billed on top of a HighLevel plan, not included in one; $9 a month billed annually

wordpress-org-plugin-count.label: Free plugins in the directory
wordpress-org-plugin-count.qualifier: as stated on the WordPress.org plugin directory

shopify-theme-store-min-perf.label: Theme Store minimum Lighthouse performance score
shopify-theme-store-min-perf.qualifier: Average across the theme’s product, collection and home page, for both desktop and mobile

shopify-theme-store-min-a11y.label: Theme Store minimum Lighthouse accessibility score
shopify-theme-store-min-a11y.qualifier: Average across the theme’s product, collection and home page, for both desktop and mobile

shopify-speed-report-retention.label: Web Performance report data retention
shopify-speed-report-retention.qualifier: The lookback window the admin report holds

shopify-speed-report-percentile.label: Web Performance report percentile
shopify-speed-report-percentile.qualifier: The default percentile shown for each Core Web Vital, in milliseconds

shopify-speed-report-lag.label: Web Performance report reporting lag
shopify-speed-report-lag.qualifier: Due to tracking and calculation processes, per Shopify’s own documentation

shopify-plan-basic.label: Basic plan price
shopify-plan-basic.qualifier: $29/mo billed yearly. US pricing as shown to a US visitor; Shopify sets plan prices by country

shopify-plan-grow.label: Grow plan price
shopify-plan-grow.qualifier: $79/mo billed yearly. US pricing as shown to a US visitor; Shopify sets plan prices by country

shopify-plan-advanced.label: Advanced plan price
shopify-plan-advanced.qualifier: $299/mo billed yearly. US pricing as shown to a US visitor; Shopify sets plan prices by country

shopify-plan-plus.label: Plus plan starting price
shopify-plan-plus.qualifier: Starting price on a 3-year term; $2,500/mo on a 1-year term. More complex, higher-volume businesses pay a variable platform fee instead

woocommerce-cart-fragments-default.label: Cart fragments script enqueueing
woocommerce-cart-fragments-default.value: only on views that render the Cart widget
woocommerce-cart-fragments-default.qualifier: Changed in WooCommerce 7.8. Before that release the script was enqueued on every page load. Third-party code that registers wc-cart-fragments as a dependency, or enqueues it explicitly, still pulls it in

woocommerce-variation-ajax-threshold.label: Variation preload threshold
woocommerce-variation-ajax-threshold.qualifier: A product with 30 or fewer variations has all of them preloaded into the page as JSON; 31 or more falls back to AJAX. Filterable via woocommerce_ajax_variation_threshold

woocommerce-guest-checkout-default.label: Guest checkout default
woocommerce-guest-checkout-default.qualifier: woocommerce_enable_guest_checkout defaults to yes. The admin label reads Enable guest checkout (recommended), under WooCommerce, Settings, Accounts and Privacy

woocommerce-classic-checkout-fields.label: Default billing fields on the classic checkout
woocommerce-classic-checkout-fields.qualifier: Default locale only. Per-country overrides make state or postcode optional in many countries. The block checkout shows 10 and requires 8, hiding company name and making phone optional

woocommerce-shipping-cost-requires-addre.label: Hide shipping costs until an address is entered
woocommerce-shipping-cost-requires-addre.qualifier: woocommerce_shipping_cost_requires_address defaults to no, so a fresh store is not hiding shipping cost by configuration. If your customers meet the price late, something else put it there

woocommerce-blocks-checkout-default.label: Cart and Checkout blocks as the default experience
woocommerce-blocks-checkout-default.qualifier: Existing stores keep the shortcode checkout when they upgrade, so a store built before November 2023 is likely still running it

statista-global-conversion-q2-2026.label: Global ecommerce visit-to-purchase rate, Q2 2026
statista-global-conversion-q2-2026.qualifier: Statista's table gives 1.4% while its own prose beneath says 1.3%. Statista is not the primary source; the page credits Salesforce Research, whose figure sits inside a dashboard with no methodology page

contentsquare-returning-vs-new-2026.label: Returning against new visitor conversion
contentsquare-returning-vs-new-2026.qualifier: From 99 billion sessions across 6,000+ sites, Q4 2024 to Q4 2025, published March 2026. Contentsquare publishes no single overall ecommerce conversion figure

wp-saml-cve-15981.label: CVE-2026-15981 severity
wp-saml-cve-15981.qualifier: Authentication bypass in the SAML Single Sign On plugin. mo_saml_validate_signature() runs a loose boolean check on the tri-state integer from PHP's openssl_verify(), so an error return of -1 evaluates as truthy and is treated as a valid signature. Affects free-edition versions up to and including 5.4.4; patched in 5.4.5. Score assigned by Wordfence as CNA

wp-saml-cve-61979.label: CVE-2026-61979 severity
wp-saml-cve-61979.qualifier: Unauthenticated privilege escalation via SAML signature algorithm confusion, affecting versions up to 5.4.3, patched in 5.4.4. The vector carries AC:H, which is what keeps it below 9.0. Patchstack assigned this record as CNA; their own write-up describes both SAML issues as 9.8. Wordfence separately assigned CVE-2026-15013 at 9.8 for what the records describe as the same mechanism and version range

wp-saml-editions.label: Product editions shipped under one WordPress plugin slug
wp-saml-editions.qualifier: Free, Standard, Premium, Premium multisite, Enterprise, VIP single site and VIP multisite all ship under the slug miniorange-saml-20-single-sign-on, each independently version-numbered. Public advisories covered the free edition only; the six paid editions were patched with no public changelog entry and no advisory, and were not listed in any vulnerability database until miniOrange supplied the full matrix on 18 August 2026

wp-saml-installs.label: Active installations, SAML Single Sign On free edition
wp-saml-installs.qualifier: WordPress.org reports the free edition only. Install counts for the six paid editions are not published anywhere, so the total exposed population is unknown

nextjs-avif-rce.label: GHSA-2xp9-vwfh-vxw4 severity
nextjs-avif-rce.qualifier: Unauthenticated remote code execution in the Image Optimization API when AVIF is processed, via a libheif flaw reachable through sharp. Affects >= 10.0.0 < 15.5.24 and < 16.3.3. No CVE identifier was assigned. The same release also fixed CVE-2026-75604, a second critical RCE affecting Windows-hosted servers only

nextjs-patched-versions-aug-2026.label: Patched versions, August 2026 security release
nextjs-patched-versions-aug-2026.qualifier: 16.3.3 is Active LTS, 15.5.24 is Maintenance LTS. Vercel pre-announced the release, then moved it forward when a second critical vulnerability was identified, so users would only need to upgrade once

gsc-ai-overview-click-counting.label: AI Overview link clicks
gsc-ai-overview-click-counting.value: counted as clicks in the Performance report
gsc-ai-overview-click-counting.qualifier: clicking a link to an external page in an AI Overview or AI Mode counts as a click, under standard impression rules

gsc-search-labs-excluded.label: Search Labs experiments
gsc-search-labs-excluded.value: excluded from all Search Console data
gsc-search-labs-excluded.qualifier: Google states experiments in Search Labs are still in active development and are not reported

google-faq-rich-result-retired.label: FAQ rich result
google-faq-rich-result-retired.qualifier: Google removed the feature documentation on 15 June 2026; FAQPage markup remains valid but earns no Search appearance

google-goto-redirect-confirmed.label: goto URL redirects on result links
google-goto-redirect-confirmed.qualifier: Google described it as a technical measure against abuse and did not address referrer, analytics or ranking impact

lovable-project-monitoring.label: Scheduled project monitoring
lovable-project-monitoring.value: Daily or weekly code and visitor-error checks, with owner emails for important findings
lovable-project-monitoring.qualifier: Must be enabled per project. By default scans run only after edits; owners can select every scheduled run. Scans require credits, can miss issues or report false positives, and do not automatically fix findings. Documentation review, not a tested project outcome

replit-uptime-monitoring.label: Recurring uptime monitoring
replit-uptime-monitoring.value: Scheduled uptime checks and downtime email alerts when enabled
replit-uptime-monitoring.qualifier: Enabled in publish settings; Scheduled Deployments are excluded. Availability checks do not establish completion of an order, enquiry or other business journey. Documentation review, not a tested project outcome

replit-post-publish-seo-rating.label: Automatic SEO Rating after publish
replit-post-publish-seo-rating.value: Lighthouse SEO audit after every successful publish of a public web-facing deployment
replit-post-publish-seo-rating.qualifier: Private and Scheduled Deployments do not produce a rating. An audit result does not guarantee indexing or rankings. Documentation review, not a tested project outcome

bolt-stripe-testing.label: Stripe integration and test-mode workflows
bolt-stripe-testing.value: Built-in Stripe payments and subscriptions, webhook handling and test-mode support
bolt-stripe-testing.qualifier: The guide explicitly requires testing successful and failed payments, webhook processing and subscription flows. Built-in handling does not establish that a particular implementation passed those tests. Documentation review, not a tested project outcome

v0-browser-testing-and-logs.label: Browser testing and deployment-log investigation
v0-browser-testing-and-logs.value: Browser interaction, terminal test execution and deployment-log investigation are documented agent capabilities
v0-browser-testing-and-logs.qualifier: The documented tools can act when requested; this source does not establish a recurring business-journey monitoring schedule. Documentation review, not a tested project outcome

wix-automation-run-logs.label: Automation run and step logs
wix-automation-run-logs.value: Each triggered automation has run records and step statuses, including failed or skipped actions
wix-automation-run-logs.qualifier: An automation log helps trace execution but does not prove that the intended recipient received or read an email. Documentation review, not a tested project outcome

framer-form-webhook-retries.label: Form webhook delivery and retries
framer-form-webhook-retries.value: Form submissions are sent by HTTP POST, with retries when the webhook does not return a 2xx response
framer-form-webhook-retries.qualifier: A successful HTTP response acknowledges receipt; it does not establish that the intended downstream business action completed. Documentation review, not a tested project outcome

webflow-recurring-aeo-agents.plan: Team and Enterprise Platform; content agents require Enterprise plus Analyze
webflow-recurring-aeo-agents.label: Recurring AEO agent recommendations
webflow-recurring-aeo-agents.value: Technical and content recommendations refresh automatically on a recurring schedule
webflow-recurring-aeo-agents.qualifier: Availability depends on plan and settings. Users review, apply and publish changes. These recommendations do not establish enquiry delivery, payment correctness or other business outcomes. Documentation review, not a tested project outcome

webflow-basic-monthly-price.label: Basic plan price
webflow-basic-monthly-price.qualifier: USD; monthly billing, per site, plus tax; existing-account renewal terms can differ.

webflow-premium-monthly-price.label: Premium plan price
webflow-premium-monthly-price.qualifier: USD; base rate on monthly billing, per site, plus tax; usage tiers and extras can change the total.

webflow-core-price.label: Core plan price
webflow-core-price.qualifier: USD; in-house Workspace plan billed yearly, plus tax. Additional paid seats and published Site plans are separate.

webflow-growth-price.label: Growth plan price
webflow-growth-price.qualifier: USD; in-house Workspace plan billed yearly, plus tax. Additional paid seats and published Site plans are separate.

shopify-oxygen-hosting.label: Oxygen hosting for Hydrogen storefronts
shopify-oxygen-hosting.value: no extra charge on paid plans: Starter, Basic, Grow, Advanced, Plus, and Pause and build
shopify-oxygen-hosting.qualifier: not available on Agentic plans; development stores and trial plans can build and test but get no public environments

shopify-headless-channel-price.label: Headless sales channel price
shopify-headless-channel-price.qualifier: the channel that issues Storefront API tokens for a non-Hydrogen storefront

shopify-hydrogen-license.label: Hydrogen licence
shopify-hydrogen-license.qualifier: no licence fee; you can also self-host it instead of using Oxygen

shopify-api-version-support.label: API version support
shopify-api-version-support.value: a new version every three months, each stable version supported for at least 12 months
shopify-api-version-support.qualifier: with at least nine months of overlap between consecutive versions

shopify-storefront-api-buyer-limits.label: Storefront API rate limits
shopify-storefront-api-buyer-limits.value: no fixed request-per-minute limit for buyer traffic
shopify-storefront-api-buyer-limits.qualifier: bots and checkout creation are limited, and tokenless access is capped at a query complexity of 1,000

shopify-oxygen-limits.label: Oxygen worker limits
shopify-oxygen-limits.value: 10 MB per worker, 30 seconds of CPU time per request and 128 MB of memory
shopify-oxygen-limits.qualifier: Oxygen doesn't support a proxy in front of a deployment

emdash-current-version.label: Current EmDash release
emdash-current-version.qualifier: published to npm on 6 October 2026; 1.0 was released on 28 September 2026 as emdash@1.0.1. An earlier emdash 1.0.0 on npm (27 April 2026) is deprecated and is not the 1.0 release

emdash-1-0-release-date.label: EmDash 1.0 release date
emdash-1-0-release-date.qualifier: Cloudflare: "a stable, free, and open source CMS built on Astro, ready to power a production website"

emdash-sandbox-cpu-limit.label: Plugin sandbox CPU time limit
emdash-sandbox-cpu-limit.qualifier: enforced on Cloudflare Workers by the Worker Loader; not enforced on Node.js

emdash-sandbox-subrequest-limit.label: Plugin sandbox subrequest limit
emdash-sandbox-subrequest-limit.qualifier: enforced on Cloudflare Workers by the Worker Loader; not enforced on Node.js

emdash-sandbox-wall-time.label: Plugin sandbox wall time limit
emdash-sandbox-wall-time.qualifier: enforced on both Cloudflare Workers and Node.js

emdash-sandbox-cloudflare-plan.label: Plan needed for the plugin sandbox on Cloudflare
emdash-sandbox-cloudflare-plan.qualifier: Dynamic Workers need the Workers Paid plan; new projects deploy on the Workers free plan unless sandboxed plugins are enabled. On Node.js the sandbox needs only the workerd package

emdash-registry-plugin-count.label: Plugins listed in the EmDash plugin registry
emdash-registry-plugin-count.qualifier: entries on the registry listing page, one of them a test entry; free plugins only so far

supabase-free-plan.label: Free plan
supabase-free-plan.qualifier: 500 MB database, 1 GB file storage, 50,000 monthly active users, 2 active projects; free projects are paused after 1 week of inactivity and have no backups

supabase-pro-price.label: Pro plan price
supabase-pro-price.qualifier: with $10 a month of compute credits, 8 GB disk per project, 100 GB file storage, 100,000 monthly active users and daily backups kept 7 days; paid projects are not paused for inactivity

supabase-ipv4-addon.label: Dedicated IPv4 address add-on
supabase-ipv4-addon.qualifier: billed at $0.0055 an hour per project, on paid plans

sanity-free-plan.label: Free plan
sanity-free-plan.qualifier: up to 20 user seats, 2 public datasets, 10,000 documents, 1 million API CDN requests and 100 GB bandwidth a month; drafts kept 3 days

sanity-growth-price.label: Growth plan price
sanity-growth-price.qualifier: up to 50 user seats, 25,000 documents, private datasets and 90 days of draft history

resend-free-plan.label: Free plan
resend-free-plan.qualifier: 3,000 emails a month, 100 a day, 3 domains; Pro is $20 a month for 50,000 emails

irp-conversion-rate-aug-2026.label: All Ecommerce Markets conversion rate, August 2026
irp-conversion-rate-aug-2026.qualifier: Transactions divided by sessions, calculated from live trading data on IRP's own platform. B2C only, Great Britain, Northern Ireland and Ireland. irp-conversion-spread-aug-2026.label: Sector spread within a single month, August 2026
irp-conversion-spread-aug-2026.qualifier: Baby and Child at the low end, Arts and Crafts at the high end. Same month, same platform, same definition, a 10.2x range

vercel-hipaa-baa.qualifier: Pro teams buy the HIPAA BAA add-on in Billing settings; Enterprise teams request it from sales

supabase-hipaa-baa.qualifier: eligible plans and setup are in Supabase's HIPAA project guide

shopify-app-price-okendo.value: Reviews, by monthly orders: free to 50 on the App Store listing; $19/mo to 200; $119/mo to 1,500; $299/mo to 3,500; $499/mo to 10,000; custom above that. Loyalty, quizzes, referrals and surveys are priced separately
shopify-app-price-okendo.qualifier: Monthly list price as published by the vendor; usage, volume and carrier charges apply where stated
